card.name: Linking words before blood count terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, the, when, and commas right before a blood count term (white cell, neutrophil, complete blood count). Seen in monitoring and hold-treatment instructions about myelosuppression.

modes.label: Monitoring of counts
modes.description: The word of after monitoring, just before complete blood counts or white cells.
modes.example: Monitoring<< of>> complete blood counts is essential during cyclo

modes.label: Threshold condition
modes.description: The word the or when after if or when, before an absolute neutrophil count threshold.
modes.example: Ganciclovir is not recommended if<< the>> absolute neutrophil count is less than

modes.label: List of lab tests
modes.description: A comma in a list of lab tests, before white blood cell count.

card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a blood count term is expected, as in monitoring or dose-hold instructions.
